dialogueVersions.defaultVersion: Press SPACE to start the tutorial
Welcome to the tutorial! Let's start your knowledge building. When you see two choice boxes like below, you can click on either of them to make a choice as Jack The Stag, the protagonist of the game

choices.choiceText: Search for plants to eat
Hire another stag to search for plants for me

dialogueVersions.defaultVersion: Good choice! Now, whenever you see me, the Narrator, or animals speaking, you can navigate to the next piece of the dialogue by pressing SPACE. Press SPACE now!
Sometimes, you might want to train your hooves a bit. It could help you later on in the game, but what do I know, hah! You can do so by clicking on the Stag. Try that now and press SPACE to continue!

Oh no! See that timer? Sometimes when the pressure will be building, you'll need to make a choice quicker. If you don't make a choice before the timer runs out, the game will automatically choose for you

choices.choiceText: Eat plants off the ground
Eat plants off of a golden plate

dialogueVersions.defaultVersion: Nice! Now that you know how to make choices, let's put it to the test with a hypothetical. A poor animal comes up to you begging for money...

choices.choiceText: You give them some coins even though you're poor yourself
You hush them with contempt and tell them to go away

dialogueVersions.defaultVersion: Based on your choices, your hidden Empathy, Ego, and Practicality scores will keep accumulating in the background, quietly and slowly deciding the fate of the game
Be empathetic to animals around and they might help you when push comes to shove. Be rational and practical or egoistical and the outcome might be different!
You should identify which choices will increase your chances of scoring high in empathy and practicality and low in egoism... or not. It's all your choice!
That was a bad pun, I know
Hi! I'm one of your animal friends, we'll speak to you directly like this. You can press SPACE to move forward!
Did you know that kindness practiced earlier in the game gives you more empathy and practicality points than later? But hush hush!
Psst, also, I wouldn't want to gather more than 5 ego points. Unless you like getting soaked by the rain and scared by lightning!
Now, it's me, the protagonist, Jack The Stag. Whenever you see me speaking, you can also move through the game by pressing SPACE. Press SPACE now!
Congrats! You finished the tutorial! Start the game by clicking the option below

choices.choiceText: Start the game

dialogueVersions.defaultVersion: Beanstalk, beanstalk, so tall and clear, tell me all I wish to hear
My mother sent me to the market through the forest. It looks like it's going to be quite an adventure.

choices.choiceText: Oh, my swift, sturdy legs! For they are what is truly important
Ohh, my golden treasures! For my fortune and glory are what matter most

dialogueVersions.egoVersion: Oh, I can smell the boasting in the air

dialogueVersions.defaultVersion: I’m famished! Could you use your legs to help me dig up some worms?

choices.choiceText: Of course, I couldn't bear leaving you in need. This is what friends are for!
Worms? For you? Surely you jest. I do not soil myself for a mere peasant frog

dialogueVersions.egoVersion: Of course… someone as 'grand' as you must keep clean..
dialogueVersions.empathyVersion: You're so kind!

dialogueVersions.egoVersion: A murmur passes through the water — disappointment, quiet and heavy. The frog has died of hunger.
dialogueVersions.empathyVersion: A small act of kindness ripples through the water — the moment passes, but its warmth remains

dialogueVersions.defaultVersion: Oh no! A sudden crisis shakes the calm of the forest!
Please, mighty stag! My hen friends are struggling in the water! Can you help them before it’s too late?

choices.choiceText: Oh, how amusing! Your tiny wings cannot hope to match my strength. Handle it yourselves
Of course! No friend should suffer while I stand idly by. I will help!

dialogueVersions.empathyVersion: Thank you, mighty stag! I will sing your praises to all the clouds—your kindness will not be forgotten!
dialogueVersions.egoVersion: I… I suppose I must manage on my own. I won’t forget this, and I’ll warn the others too

dialogueVersions.defaultVersion: Is someone there? I hear the clicking of hooves

choices.choiceText: Obviously, it's me, the King of The Clouds! Don't you see?
Ah, it's just me, Stag. I'm over here

dialogueVersions.egoVersion: I would.. if I weren't blind
dialogueVersions.empathyVersion: Ah, pardon me, I would've noticed if it wasn't for my eyesight! I've just received a blindness diagnosis from Doctor Bird

choices.choiceText: Oh really? I bet you'd love to hear about my beauty if you can't witness it yourself, I'll tell you all about it
Oh that's understable. I'm sorry. How are you doing nowadays?

dialogueVersions.egoVersion: Um, not really..
dialogueVersions.empathyVersion: Thanks for asking, not too bad. Your compassion prompts me to ask: I’ll trade you a beanstalk secret for a bit of protection. Sound fair?

dialogueVersions.egoVersion: I am dressed in gold. My treasures gleam with twelve jewels of pure perfection...
dialogueVersions.empathyVersion: So you say? We have a deal

dialogueVersions.egoVersion: Mhm..
dialogueVersions.empathyVersion: There's a giant near the creek. He’s fast, but he’s clumsy in the bushes. If he jumps, don't look back—just trust your feet and use your antlers

dialogueVersions.egoVersion: Can you imagine such glory?
dialogueVersions.empathyVersion: Oh that's definitely worth to know!

dialogueVersions.egoVersion: Thanks.. I can't wait to tell others about you...
dialogueVersions.empathyVersion: Be careful out there!

dialogueVersions.defaultVersion: Hey there again! I've been keeping an eye on you
Are you new here? What's that distinguished posture?
You aren't the King of The Clouds last time I checked...
Walking regally makes you unbalanced, but your reflection, oh how beautiful it is...
Walking steadily would keep you balanced and secure...
but do you really want to sacrifice the feeling of being royal?

choices.choiceText: Walk through the forest with a high, heavy-footed stride to maintain a regal posture
Walk balanced. You never know how your experience of good footing might help later on

dialogueVersions.defaultVersion: Don't you want to test your hooves before you embark on a trip through the forest?
Ah, seems like some gossip has spread already anyway...
There's some negativity in the air...
Have you noticed how he walks lately? Antlers high, eyes forward. He barely looks at us
My opinion is far from favourable. He sold me to an old man for five mere beans!
They say he thinks himself above the village now too
I don’t know if that’s true… but no one has said otherwise...

choices.choiceText: Friends, I hear your whispers. Is there worry in your hearts? Let us speak openly
Hush, peasants. Your gossip is beneath me. Let silence remind you of your place

dialogueVersions.egoVersion: Huh? Laughable. The true colors are showing
dialogueVersions.empathyVersion: Oh, that's unexpected. We... we never thought a Stag of your stature would care for our tiny worries!

dialogueVersions.egoVersion: We will keep our distance. Loud antlers draw quiet enemies
dialogueVersions.empathyVersion: We worried you would laugh at us… but you're listening. That matters more than you know

dialogueVersions.egoVersion: The clouds feel lighter. By choosing to listen, you've gained some friendly eyes and ears
dialogueVersions.empathyVersion: Seems like you've frustrated the Forest Council a bit...

dialogueVersions.defaultVersion: So much of this walking... I've grown thirsty
The water here glows almost radioactively — beautiful, shimmering, yet somewhat... wrong. The forest grows quiet around it.
Hey you! Watch out! The pond here is not what you think it is...
Drink deeply from it and it will restore your full health, but ruin some of your beauty
Drink only a sip of the clean surface, and it'll elevate your looks but leave you exhausted
I'd choose wisely!

choices.choiceText: I'll drink a lot of this magical water. How could I not if it promises immense beauty
I'll stick to being practical — I need my health after all

dialogueVersions.egoVersion: You take a deep, deep gulp, careful not to disturb your reflection. Even more beauty, but your knees tremble with fatigue
dialogueVersions.practicalityVersion: A shallow sip later, and although your beauty has taken a toll, you can feel yourself getting so much stronger

dialogueVersions.defaultVersion: Do you hear that? Sounds like a group of birds chirping about danger...

choices.choiceText: Better heed the birds' advice and move cautiously...
I wouldn't worry about that. What would they know

dialogueVersions.defaultVersion: But in the meantime... what are these?
Seems like they might be useful
Could I use them to build myself a... castle? Imagine that!
My quest to become the King of The Clouds would surely be complete soon after!

choices.choiceText: Build yourself a castle out of this gold
I could use the gold to start helping animals who might need it

dialogueVersions.defaultVersion: A beautiful harp glimmers at the water's edge.. the legend says that it will start to sing if you touch it
I better not touch it then. I have a very particular fear of mid-sized singing objects.
And what's this? Is that...
A beanstalk? Yes. This one leads up to the Giant's castle in the clouds. Are you sure you wish to head there...

dialogueVersions.egoVersion: I'd rather not come across the giant. So, now, onto castle building! Oh wait, what's that haunting feeling, and that sound...
dialogueVersions.empathyVersion: I'd rather not come across the giant. Let's share this gold instead! Oh wait, what's that haunting feeling, and that sound..

dialogueVersions.defaultVersion: Worry is starting to build...
Just need to be a little quiet now...
But... I feel a sense of..
...imminent danger in the air

choices.choiceText: Let out a noble roar to assert dominance and scare that silly giant
Assume your fighting position to be best prepared for any attack

dialogueVersions.egoVersion: This is fine... I am the greatest and am not scared of any giant. I am the King of the clouds after all!
dialogueVersions.practicalityVersion: Whatever comes, my skills will take care of it. But if not, will someone help?
dialogueVersions.empathyVersion: Oh no... hopefully my friends will help me...

dialogueVersions.egoVersion: I've seen your pride, Stag… I’ll leave you to your vanity.
dialogueVersions.practicalityVersion: I've to watch from afar. The fear may scare me, but your skill is still with you!
dialogueVersions.empathyVersion: Stag, your care has not gone unnoticed! I’ll organise others to help right away!

dialogueVersions.egoVersion: Hmph! Your inflated level of pride doesn't really convince us to help, "King of The Clouds"...
dialogueVersions.practicalityVersion: you move well and can survive the forest!
dialogueVersions.empathyVersion: Thank you for helping us earlier!

dialogueVersions.egoVersion: I'm small and ugly, but the Giant never sees me. Can you say the same, Big-Horns?
dialogueVersions.practicalityVersion: you move well and can survive the forest!
dialogueVersions.empathyVersion: We’ll jump to your rescue!

dialogueVersions.egoVersion: Your antlers may shine, but your heart does not. We cannot help you.
dialogueVersions.practicalityVersion: We see you are capable… that should be enough!
dialogueVersions.empathyVersion: Stag, your kindness saved us before! We will flock around you!

dialogueVersions.egoVersion: A proud stag stands alone. We will let him face the forest himself.
dialogueVersions.practicalityVersion: The fear makes us stay away, but you're clever and fast
dialogueVersions.empathyVersion: A friend who cares is a friend indeed. We will stay close!

dialogueVersions.egoVersion: The stag relies on pride… hah, what easy prey
dialogueVersions.practicalityVersion: I heard of his skills, but let's see how they measure against ME!
dialogueVersions.empathyVersion: I heard the birds chirping about being his popularity. But maybe all of that were lies

dialogueVersions.egoVersion: I don't need the help of you lot. Victory is mine whether you like it or not
dialogueVersions.practicalityVersion: Others are keeping to themselves, but they do give some good advice
dialogueVersions.empathyVersion: All that kindness warms my heart so intensely. I can feel your protection, friends!

dialogueVersions.defaultVersion: Giant's feast!

dialogueVersions.egoVersion: Bring it on, peasant! Hah!
dialogueVersions.practicalityVersion: I can do this, I can do this, I can do this
dialogueVersions.empathyVersion: Friends! You're here!

dialogueVersions.egoVersion: Death. Death has come.
dialogueVersions.practicalityVersion: The stag's skill saved its life, but without others around, the victory feels... hollow
dialogueVersions.empathyVersion: The stag's kindness is remembered. Animals gather around, offering their aid and gratitude

dialogueVersions.egoVersion: But... but I am.. I was the greatest!
dialogueVersions.practicalityVersion: I thought I was the forest’s marvel, but…
dialogueVersions.empathyVersion: I thought my antlers were all that mattered...

dialogueVersions.egoVersion: How could this be...
dialogueVersions.empathyVersion: ...but it was my legs, my care, and my friends that saved me

dialogueVersions.egoVersion: ...I valued what glittered
dialogueVersions.empathyVersion: I see now that kindness and care are as strong as legs or antlers

dialogueVersions.egoVersion: ...ignored what truly mattered
dialogueVersions.practicalityVersion: ...yet some subtle things slipped past me
dialogueVersions.empathyVersion: Friends make the forest safer

dialogueVersions.egoVersion: Alone, the stag learned the cost of vanity and pride
dialogueVersions.practicalityVersion: Surviving through skill alone, the stag realized...
dialogueVersions.empathyVersion: Surrounded by friends, the stag finally understands...

dialogueVersions.egoVersion: What was truly valuable went underrated...
dialogueVersions.practicalityVersion: you can value your own skill, but valuing those around as well brings ultimate peace in the end
dialogueVersions.empathyVersion: what is truly valuable is often underrated

choices.choiceText: Restart game
Exit game
